PUBG Mobile partners with Bentley to bring luxury vehicles to the game
The collaboration brings three Bentley models alongside vehicle customisation options and accessories until January 12th, 2025

November 23, 2026

PUBG Mobile has partnered with Bentley to introduce three of the brand's 2025 models.
The collaboration runs from November 20th, 2026 to January 12th, 2027.

PUBG Mobile has partnered with British luxury car manufacturer Bentley to introduce three of its vehicles into the battle royale game.
The collaboration went live on November 20th, 2026 and will continue to run until January 12th, 2027.
The partnership gives players the opportunity to purchase three Bentley models alongside a selection of branded accessories and customisation options.
The vehicles include the Continental GTC Mulliner convertible, Flying Spur Mulliner sedan and the Bentayga Azure SUV. Each vehicle comes with its own selection of exclusive finishes.
Luxury car collab
Alongside the cars themselves, players can purchase Bentley-themed cosmetics, including the Bentley parachute and other in-game look items, such as sunglasses, which are available in two colours.
The partnership also introduces additional vehicle customisation options, including a range of brake calliper colours and a selection of wheel designs.
The collaboration follows the worldwide launch of
PUBG Mobile Flash
on November 12th, 2026, a lightweight version of PUBG Mobile on iOS and Android.
Elsewhere, Netflix is developing a
live-action adaptation of Krafton’s PUBG
with Donald Glover set to write and direct.
